notes: Customer profile: mid-market analytics SaaS (B2B), heavy interactive product workflows + in-app assistant. Fast-growing product org, care about cost predictability.
POC takeaways: Hosted API good for dev velocity & feature parity checks. Production needs: predictable concurrency, data isolation, encryption-at-rest with KMS, and retention controls.
Quoted requirement from CTO: "We need 99.9% uptime with regional failover, and an SLA that accounts for model fallback latency during incidents."

Traffic shape observed in trial: weekday daytime peak between 10:00-14:00 PST; baseline ~5-7 QPS; bursts up to ~18 QPS for batch import flows. Token mix skewed to short service prompts but summarization spikes increase token consumption by ~3x during nightly jobs.

Redwood engineering notes: enable prefix KV caching for product assistant (saves ~25% token cost on repeat user context). Suggested quantization for embeddings workload to reduce memory footprint on Dedicated nodes.

Commercial: interested in 12-month reserved capacity if pricing supports 30-40% discount vs hosted spend at projected volumes. Procurement flagged data residency clause for EU customers (must restrict EU data to EU region).
Customer communicated risk tolerance: moderate. Will proceed quickly if Dedicated sizing aligns with forecast and overage model is acceptable.
Common abbreviations used in notes: QPS=queries per second, P95=95th percentile latency, SOW=statement of work, KMS=key management service.
workload_profile: Primarily chat/in-app assistant (interactive). Embeddings for search indexing nightly. Periodic long-form summarization jobs cause token spikes.
qps_observed: sustained 6 QPS, typical peak bursts to 18 QPS during demo
peak_concurrency_observed: concurrent sessions ~40 active users during peak test; backend concurrency estimate ~12 workers
token_mix_estimate: short <30 tokens: 60%, mid 30-200 tokens: 30%, long >200 tokens: 10%; avg tokens per request (in+out) ~220
capacity_sizing_recommendation: Starter Dedicated pool: 2x A100-80GB-equivalent nodes with KV cache + autoscale policy to add 1 node on sustained 75% GPU util; recommended growth plan: move to 4 nodes at +2x traffic
